content.short: Mercle enables a decentralized web3 identity and reputation data layer for dapps, with attestations for on-chain and off-chain user activities.
content.description: Mercle aims to establish a decentralized identity and reputation data layer for web3 dapps. It enables dapps to issue attestations for user activity, both on-chain and off-chain. At its core, Mercle provides a foundation for decentralized identities that can support governance, efficient coordination, and smart token reward distribution. In addition, it functions as a reputation tool, letting any dapp tap into Mercle to determine a web3 user’s reputation, globally as well as within a specific community.
content.meta: Mercle creates a decentralized web3 identity and reputation data layer for dapps. Discover Mercle and other Identity Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
